title.narrative: Reaching the EU Green Deal Targets by Turkish Automotive Industry

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to contribute to the achievement of the European Union Green Deal targets by improving the capacity of the Turkish Automotive Sector in the areas of Circular Economy and Resource Efficiency and Sustainable Production and Consumption.

Specific objectives of the action are the following:

-Increasing the institutional and technical capacity of Turkish AutomotiveManufacturers¿ Association (OSD) on European Green Deal targets

-Increasing theinstitutional and technical capacity of automotive manufacturers (OEMs) and suppliers on European Green Deal

-Increasing synergy and cooperation with other business NGO¿s and government institutions on European Green Deal objectives and related efforts

-Establishing networks with counterparts within the European Union

-Creating reliable source of information for all interested parties

The project was awarded under the call for proposal that aims to support the improvement of the capacities of civil society organisations towards the achievement of the ambitious targets of the European Green Deal.
